dataset.source: tardis.dev; Binance USDT-pair data, paper§3.1 pp.4–5
dataset.venue: Binance; Spot/futures segment not explicitly identified in paper
dataset.frequency: 30-minute intraday RV, resampled/represented every5minutes; exact prose given in§3.1
dataset.variance_vs_standard_deviation: Eq1 is sum of squared log returns, without sqrt/centering/population divisor. Do not equate it to project sigma7.
dataset.horizon: Authors describe one-day-ahead intraday RV path; each midnight model predicts next day288five-minute observations; formulas use t+u, so exact horizon convention should be reconciled before replication.
dataset.winsorization: alpha=1 percentile winsorization reported in footnote4,p.5; computation period/train-only status not stated in paper.
dataset.features: Own RV dynamic/static lags (u,1H,6H,12H,1d,1w,1m,6m capped byL_train), cross-pair/cluster information by scheme; some HAR variants add equity session dummies/VIXM orderbook RV.

protocol.neural_training_internal_validation: PaperFigure5/§4.1:80%training/20%validation ofL_train; daily rolling fit at midnight, next-day test288observations.
protocol.pooling: UAM stacks asset data, one-hot asset indicators;20assets are one study, not20papers.
protocol.model_selection: Optuna used for tree tuning; paperAppendixA and authorcode give neural search space; best models selected fromreportedOOSQLIKE.
protocol.statistical_tests: Pairwise Diebold–Mariano statistics Eq11–12 andAppendixB; forecastloss/long-runvariance/multiplicity calibration not fully documented in paper.

architectures_and_roles.role: Deep-learning technique in proposed universal/commonality framework; compared with classical/tree/linear approaches. Not automatically a simple DL baseline from the paper.

source_code_only.architecture: nn.LSTM followed by a Linear layer or optional nn.Sequential dense/ReLU head

architectures_and_roles.role: Internal output head; no independently fitted/evaluated MLP comparator verified in manuscript.
No empirical CNN comparator identified; WaveNet is suggested as future work in§7,p.25.

DL_specific_metrics: No separately identified LSTM QLIKE/MSE row inTable2 orAppendixB; do not assign classical/tree best-model values to LSTM. Numerical retrieval from author result databases was not performed.

quality_and_limits.finding: Continuous RV forecast for20cryptoassets includingBTC; a direct appliedDLstudy should be represented in the expanded balanced corpus, with proposed/baseline roles separated.
Do not exclude this appliedstudy just because it adds no independentMLP/CNN recurrence. Broad crypto corpus inclusion and strict baseline-frequency eligibility are separate decisions.
No DOI/journal/individual index record or quartile verified; manuscript date is not an editorial acceptance date.
RV variance,30min aggregation,5min grid and next-day path differ from daily sigma7/h1/OHLCV; cannot rank reportedQLIKE against projectRMSE.

Winsorization1% and per-asset maxabs scaling are reported, but paperdoes not fully specify training-only boundaries for every transformation/clustering step. Authorcode UAMobjective computes scaling frominternaltraining dates; this does not certify everypaperstage is leakage-free.
Best model perlookback/regime is selected fromreportedOOSscores; no separately specified post-selection finalholdout or repeatedneural seeds/CI in manuscript.
Column L_train=1m prints AR^(CAM,1w,LightGBM), repeating1w label; preserve printedvalue0.75 and flag label rather than silently correcting.
§4.3names LSTM/VAR forUAM, whileTable2 andAppendixA also listUAMLightGBM. Authorcode confirms UAMLightGBM branch. Narrative does not enumerate all implementations consistently.
§5.2/AppendixC describeETH asreceiver, whereas§6.1 calls itconsistentnettransmitter. Tradingresults are downstream and not metrics ofMLPforecastsuperiority.
DMstatistics reported forselectedwinnersversusSAM; dependence,horizon,postselection andmultiplicity requirecriticism, not automaticvalidity.
